_meta.comment: All thresholds of the great_wave tests live here (spec section 9). Tests must never change these values, the base contour or the camera to make a test pass; on failure report by how much and where.
_meta.entry_format: Every check is {value, unit, op, provenance, tiers:{spec, user_relaxed_5pct}, ...}. 'value' is always identical to tiers.spec. 'op' tells how the measured quantity m is compared with the limit v: abs_le |m|<=v, le m<=v, lt m<v, ge m>=v, gt m>v, eq m==v. A check with value null is report-only (no numeric threshold exists in the spec).

provenance_vocabulary.backlog: the spec attributes the value to the backlog sheet (spec section 5 header: tolerances follow the backlog's initial comparison targets; section 7: provisional backlog value)
provenance_vocabulary.spec initial value: initial value introduced by great_wave_blender_prompt.md itself (or a condition of the spec that is not attributed to the backlog)

_meta.backlog_access_note: The foundation agent did NOT read the backlog sheet: every 'backlog' provenance in this file repeats what the spec file says. Afterwards docs/backlog_crosscheck.md (2026-09-20) cross-checked ONE readable copy, the definition sheet of 'backlog6_20260917_2242' (state of 2026-09-17 22:42; the two newer .xlsm files could not be read). FOUND there and consistent with the spec: the painting file 3859 x 2594 px and '% = of image height'; the 3D reference model is not the shape truth; the contour test uses the contour without claws and spray; contour agreement mean <= 1 % / 95 % of the points <= 2 % (S7); crest height and trough-to-crest height within 2 % (S1 / S3); fixed comparison view; start of the curl = the head tip first crosses the crest plumb line (M3). FOUND there but DIFFERENT from the spec: S7 is measured in BOTH directions; M6 reads '3 x the MEDIAN of the neighbouring frames, excluding the transition to the stop'; the still pose is held 10 s with movement <= 0.2 % of image height. NOT FOUND there although the spec quotes the backlog: the size setting (H = 0.8-1.0 x boat length 13 m), the on-board viewpoint, the initial durations 4 / 3 / 2.5 s. docs/backlog_crosscheck.md makes NO statement about the remaining 'backlog' values of this file (S2, S5 2 % / 5 deg, S6 59.2 %, S8 15 deg, G3 3 % H): they are still only what the spec file says.
_meta.pct_unit_note: '% of image height' : 1 % = 25.94 px = 0.0151515 H (H = 11 m -> 0.1667 m). Horizontal differences are ALSO expressed in % of image HEIGHT (dx_px / 2594 * 100).

spec.note: The thresholds exactly as written in the spec.

user_relaxed_5pct.provenance: user chat message 2026-09-20: 各个误差率可以允许在5%以内
user_relaxed_5pct.note: INTERPRETATION PENDING USER CONFIRMATION. Working interpretation chosen by the orchestrator: positional tolerances become 5 % of image height and S3 becomes +-5 %; every threshold that is not a positional tolerance (angles, motion ratios, mesh checks, the S6 outer boundary) is left identical to the spec tier. Tests must report pass/fail for BOTH tiers and never silently choose one.

target.provenance: backlog / earlier pixel analysis quoted by the spec; to be re-measured in step 1 (spec section 5 note 4)

dx_pct_h.comment: horizontal offset of the crest from the target

dz_pct_h.comment: vertical offset of the crest from the target

S2.title: 内側の弧の最深点 (deepest point of the inner arc)

target.provenance: backlog / earlier pixel analysis quoted by the spec; to be re-measured in step 1

dist_pct_h.comment: The spec says '<= 2 % of image height' without 'each'; implemented as Euclidean distance. Tests also report dx and dz separately so the per-axis reading can be judged as well.

S3.title: 谷から波頂の高さ (trough-to-crest height)

target.provenance: backlog / earlier pixel analysis quoted by the spec

height_err_pct_h.comment: measured height in % of image height minus 66.0. Read as percentage points of image height (64..68). If the user means a relative +-2 % of the height, the band would be 66 +- 1.32; tests report the raw number so both readings can be judged.

S4.title: 背の傾き (slope of the back)

target.provenance: backlog / earlier pixel analysis quoted by the spec ('about')

mid_is_steepest.comment: the middle part of the back is the steepest

flattens_towards_crest.comment: slope decreases gradually from the steepest point to the crest

top_is_round_no_corner.comment: rounded top without a kink; numerically covered by S8

S5.title: 波頭の先, 爪を含まない (head tip without claws)

target.source: measured on target/base_contour.json (position and direction of the right-most point of the head on the base contour)

pos_pct_h.comment: distance between the mesh head tip and the base-contour head tip

dir_deg.comment: direction difference of the head tip; an angle, not covered by the 5 % statement

S6.title: 爪を含む最右点, 外側の境界のみ (right-most point incl. claws; outer bound only)

target.provenance: backlog / earlier pixel analysis quoted by the spec

body_rightmost_left_pct.comment: the right-most point of the wave BODY must stay left of the claw tip (X_H < 0.4734). A bound, not a tolerance: identical in both tiers. S5 and S6 are different things; do not pull the body out to 59.2 %.

S7.title: 輪郭の一致 (contour agreement: 背 / 波頭 / 内側の弧)

mean_dev_pct_h.comment: per segment; spans of the base contour that were completed by hand/estimate (occluded by the front wave or the boat) are excluded

p95_dev_pct_h.comment: per segment; 95 % of the points within this deviation

max_tangent_diff_deg.comment: tangent direction difference between neighbouring samples; provenance inferred from the section 5 header (section 10.4 names only the spacing as a spec-initial value)

sample_spacing_pct_h.comment: a test setting, not a pass/fail limit; the authoritative copy is params.json S8_sample_spacing_pct

M1.title: 開始フレームはうねり (start frame is a swell)

start_theta_max_deg.comment: maximum slope of the front face in the start frame; section 6.3 gives no backlog attribution

h_monotonic_violation_H.comment: largest frame-to-frame decrease of h(t) inside the rise phase; h must rise monotonically until the overhang phase starts

theta_start_deg.comment: theta at the start of the phase

theta_end_deg.comment: theta reached at the end of the phase; theta must change continuously

o_monotonic_violation_H.comment: largest frame-to-frame decrease of the overhang o(t) inside the phase

h_drop_pct.unit: % of h at the start of the phase
h_drop_pct.comment: drop of h during the phase

tip_crosses_crest_plumb.comment: the head tip passes the plumb line of the crest towards the boat side

phi_monotonic_violation_deg.comment: largest frame-to-frame upward turn of phi(t); phi must turn downward monotonically and join the final shape continuously

decel_window_s.comment: a test setting: the contour speed must decrease gradually during this window before the stop

stop_speed_ratio.unit: fraction of the maximum contour speed of the whole animation
stop_speed_ratio.comment: contour speed at the instant of stopping

post_stop_max_disp_H.comment: shape does not change after the stop; no jump of position or shape when the final shape is reached (the jump itself is covered by M6)

M6.title: 全体: 突跳なし (no sudden jumps)

jump_ratio.unit: x displacement of the neighbouring frame pairs
jump_ratio.comment: max contour displacement between two adjacent frames divided by that of the preceding / following frame pair

G1.title: トポロジーと UV が全フレーム不変 (constant topology and UV)

n_topology_or_uv_changes.comment: vertex count, faces and UV identical on every frame

G2.title: 裾の段差 (hem step against the still-water level)

hem_step_pct_H.comment: outer mesh border on every frame; relative to the wave height, NOT to the image height

G3.title: 波頭の縁の厚み (thickness of the head rim)

rim_thickness_pct_H.comment: provisional backlog value according to spec section 7

n_self_intersections.comment: final frame and every sampled frame

frame_step.comment: a test setting: sampling interval of the frames that are checked

rebuild_max_abs_diff_m.comment: two rebuilds from the same params give bit-identical vertex positions

interpretations._comment: ADDED 2026-09-20 (test-harness hardening). NOT thresholds of the spec: tolerances and settings that the TEST CODE chose and that can influence a verdict. The code keeps its defaults in tests/common_test.py TEST_SETTINGS and src/gw/profile_metrics.py DEFAULT_PARAMS; this block is the reference copy. On every run common_test.settings_audit() compares the values actually used (after params.json 'test_settings' / 'measure_params', --set, --res-scale, --hold-frames, --frame-step) with the values below. Any difference - also a code default that no longer matches this file, and any verdict-relevant setting that is not listed here - appends ' (NON-DEFAULT SETTINGS)' to the verdict, is listed in metrics.json / summary.md and makes the exit code non-zero. Settings that only feed report-only values are not listed (common_test.REPORT_ONLY_SETTINGS / REPORT_ONLY_MEASURE_PARAMS). The S8 sample spacing is judged by its own check S8.sample_spacing_pct_h.
interpretations.entry_format: {value, unit, used_by, provenance, comment}; provenance of every entry: 'orchestrator interpretation, pending user confirmation'

shape_res_scale.comment: mask resolution factor of test_shape (1.0 = 3859 x 2594, the painting's own grid)

motion_res_scale.comment: mask resolution factor of test_motion; with exact crossings the accuracy does not depend on it (docs/measurement_definitions.md section 7)

mesh_res_scale.comment: mask resolution factor of the CAM_print profile that test_mesh uses to locate the visible head tip (G3)

monotonic_noise_floor_H.comment: INTERPRETATION: a frame-to-frame decrease of h / o smaller than this (H units; = 0.0066 % of image height = 1.1 mm at H = 11 m) counts as measurement noise and is judged as 0. Documented noise of the measurement: 5e-6 H (h), 1.5e-4 H (o, x_c). The raw value is always reported next to the judged one.

monotonic_noise_floor_deg.comment: INTERPRETATION: same for phi (documented measurement error <= 0.07 deg per frame -> <= 0.14 deg per difference)

static_disp_eps_H.comment: INTERPRETATION: a contour displacement at or below this (H units; 0.011 mm at H = 11 m) counts as 'not moving' (stop detection, M5 post-stop)

disp_z_min_H.comment: contour samples below this height (the run along the still water) are ignored in the contour displacement (pm.measure_sequence default)

jump_floor_frac_of_vmax.unit: fraction of the largest per-frame contour displacement
jump_floor_frac_of_vmax.comment: INTERPRETATION (M6): the neighbour displacement in the denominator of the jump ratio is never taken smaller than this fraction of the largest per-frame displacement; otherwise every start from rest / arrival at rest would be a 'jump' (x / 0)

hold_frames.comment: frames evaluated AFTER the final frame to check 'the shape does not change after the stop' (M5)

g3_n_sections.comment: number of cross-sections (planes Y = const) used for the rim thickness

g3_y_percentiles.unit: percentiles of the Y coordinates of the crest_rim vertices
g3_y_percentiles.comment: the sections are spread between these percentiles of the Y coordinates of the crest_rim vertices

g3_tip_match_pct_h.comment: INTERPRETATION: a section is JUDGED when its own head tip lies within this distance (% of image height) of the head tip seen by CAM_print, i.e. it forms the visible rim; tapered end sections are reported only

g3_normal_window_pct_H.comment: half length (in % of H, along the section) of the symmetric chord that gives the tangent / inward normal at the rim point

g3_exclude_pct_H.comment: curve points closer than this (arc length, % of H) to the rim point are not used for the inscribed circle (their ratio 0/0 is ill-conditioned)

g3_probe_offsets_pct_H.comment: the inscribed-circle diameter is the median over rim points shifted by these arc lengths (% of H)

g4_eps_rel_H.comment: geometric tolerance of the triangle-triangle test as a fraction of H: vertices closer than this to the other triangle's plane count as touching, intersection segments shorter than this are ignored

g4_min_plane_angle_deg.comment: triangle pairs whose planes are closer to parallel than this are classified 'coplanar / touching', not as a crossing

g5_n_frames.comment: number of frames (evenly spread from the first to the final frame) whose vertex positions are compared bit-exactly between rebuilds

motion_frame_step.comment: test_motion evaluates every n-th frame (--frame-step). Anything but 1 makes M5 / M6 meaningless for acceptance, so it is treated like a changed tolerance (verdict suffix NON-DEFAULT SETTINGS)

in_s7_false_max_share_pct.comment: INTERPRETATION (validity): largest share (% of the segment's arc length on the base contour / % of the model's samples of the segment) that may be excluded from S7 because the base contour is flagged in_S7 = false there. Above it the S7 verdict of that segment covers too little of the segment and the run is INVALID. Measured shares 2026-09-20: official base contour inner arc 20.8 %, back / head 0 %; synthetic fixture inner arc 27.5 %. The shares are always reported as T.<segment>.in_s7_false_share_pct / T.<segment>.model_samples_not_counted_share_pct.

z_still_H.comment: still-water / trough level in H units (spec section 4: Z = 0)

extremum_tol_pct_h.comment: crest / tip / deepest point = mid-point of the run of samples within this distance (in % of image height) of the extreme coordinate; makes flat tops and vertical walls well defined

tip_rule.comment: how the head tip is DETECTED (model profiles; base contour: consistency check). 'max_reversal' = on the front stretch [crest, first sample with Z <= z_still + trough_tol] take the pair (T before D) with the largest come-back X(T) - X(D); T = head tip = right-most point of the whole overhanging head (crest .. deepest point), D = inner-arc deepest point. Ripples and lobes of any size between crest and D cannot truncate the head, and the run along the water to the right frame edge cannot be picked (X never comes back there). 'first_reversal' = legacy rule (first local X maximum after the crest that is followed by a reversal of tip_min_reversal_pct_h): identical on single-nosed heads, stops at the first lobe on a lobed head (was 16 % of image height away from the json tip on the finger-scale base contour). The legacy point is always reported as landmark 'overhang_onset'.

used_by: overhang yes / no: S2, S5, S6, S7, M2, M3
tip_min_reversal_pct_h.comment: an overhang (head tip, inner arc) exists when the largest come-back of X on the front stretch exceeds this; smaller come-backs count as a non-overhanging profile (o = 0). Unchanged from the legacy rule, so the overhang ONSET frame of a motion is the same as before.

segmentation_check_tol_pct_h.comment: measure_base_contour: largest allowed distance between the landmarks that follow from the json joints (crest, head tip, deepest point) and the landmarks DETECTED on the same polyline; above it the target and the model are not segmented in the same way and test_shape marks the run INVALID (orchestrator task, 2026-09-20)

used_by: end of the inner arc (S7, S8)
trough_tol_pct_h.comment: the inner arc / front face ends where Z first gets within this distance of the still-water level

theta_window_pct_h.comment: chord length used as tangent for theta (front-face inclination)

theta_step_pct_h.comment: arc-length step at which theta is evaluated

phi_skip_H.comment: arc length before the tip that is skipped for phi (the rounded rim cap; rim radius <= 1.5 % H by spec section 7)

phi_len_H.comment: length of the top-side window used for phi ('the last few % H before the tip')

phi_min_len_H.comment: phi is not reported when the head is too short for a window of at least this length

s4_left_window_pct_h.comment: S4 'near the left end': chord over this arc length from the left frame edge

s4_tangent_window_pct_h.comment: chord length used as tangent for the slope curve of the back

s4_before_crest_window_pct_h.comment: S4 'before the crest': chord of the back between these arc-length distances before the crest

s4_monotone_tol_deg.comment: tolerance for 'slope decreases gradually towards the crest'

s4_crest_zone_pct_h.comment: 'top is round, no corner': S8 turn angles within this arc-length distance of the crest

s8_n_phases.comment: S8 is evaluated for this many sample phases (offsets of spacing / n) so a kink cannot hide between samples

s8_tip_exclusion_pct_h.comment: INTERPRETATION: S8 junctions closer than this (arc length) to the head tip are not judged, because a rim thinner than 3 % H turns ~180 deg within ~3 % of image height

s8_limit_deg.comment: copy of thresholds.json S8.max_tangent_diff_deg, only used for the boolean S4 'no corner' flag

s7_sample_spacing_pct_h.comment: spacing of the samples whose distance is measured for S7 (denser than the S8 spacing)

s7_segment_margin_pct_h.comment: a segment is compared with the same segment of the other contour extended by this arc length into its neighbours, so a slightly different crest / tip split does not create fake deviation

silhouette.SPECK_AREA_PX_FULL_RES.unit: px at 3859 x 2594 (scaled with the square of the mask resolution)
used_by: validity of test_shape / test_motion: a removed silhouette component of at least this area is an 'island' -> INVALID; smaller ones are specks (reported)
silhouette.SPECK_AREA_PX_FULL_RES.comment: constant of src/gw/silhouette.py; raster noise of thin slivers must not invalidate a run, a detached part must
